title: Plan P: Building an AI Customer-Service Agent
summary: Business mapping → knowledge base → intent & FAQ → dialogue flow → channel integration → human fallback & iteration
scenario: Best for e-commerce, SaaS, websites and support teams — offloading repeat queries to an AI agent available 24/7.

steps.title: Map the business
steps.detail: List the frequent query types (pre-sale / after-sale / logistics / returns / product usage), estimate their share, and decide what is fully automated, what escalates, and what the AI must never promise.
steps.tips: Solve the 80% of top-frequency questions first and leave the long tail to humans — don't chase 100% coverage on day one.

steps.title: Build the knowledge base
steps.detail: Structure FAQs, product specs and policy terms into a searchable knowledge base wired through RAG. Knowledge quality decides answer accuracy.
steps.tips: Write each entry as 'question → standard answer → source link'; refresh from real tickets regularly.

steps.title: Intents and FAQ config
steps.detail: Configure intent detection (price / logistics / returns / complaints), bind each to standard answers, and set fallback copy plus human-handoff triggers.
steps.tips: Keep to 5-8 main intents; over-splitting causes misclassification.

steps.title: Design the dialogue flow
steps.detail: Build multi-turn flows: ask for the order number, confirm the issue, offer a solution, check satisfaction. Route sensitive topics (refunds, complaints, legal) straight to humans.
steps.tips: When the AI is unsure, it must offer a human handoff — never answer blind.

steps.title: Integrate channels
steps.detail: Connect WeCom / DingTalk / website / app support entry points; configure human-in-the-loop (AI answers first, human takeover visible).
steps.tips: Gray-launch one channel before rolling out; keep all conversation logs for optimization.

steps.title: Fallback and iterate
steps.detail: Daily-sample conversation logs: wrong answers go into the knowledge base, over-escalations get tighter copy; run periodic 'answer accuracy' evaluations.
steps.tips: Set a confidence threshold: below it auto-escalate to a human, above it auto-answer.

pitfalls.title: Thin knowledge base
pitfalls.detail: Missing knowledge makes the AI fabricate answers; fill the top-frequency questions before launch.

pitfalls.title: Irrelevant answers
pitfalls.detail: Misclassified intents produce irrelevant replies; tighten intents and strengthen fallback copy.

pitfalls.title: Wrong answers on sensitive topics
pitfalls.detail: Refunds, complaints and legal must force human handoff — never let the AI improvise.

pitfalls.title: No human fallback
pitfalls.detail: Full automation without an out angers customers; keep human-in-the-loop and handoff channels.
